column2: Hell if I know.
column3: Hell if I know.

column3: Snake, there's one problem with that route.

tunnel that leads to the fortress is sealed.

top of the mountains. Meet me there.

tell you.

you in the jungle at the foot of the mountains.

Don't underestimate him. He's known as
the father of modern sniping.

column3:

column2: The forest...
column3: The forest...

column2: Stay alert.

column2:
En la fortaleza, en Groznyj Grad. El Doctor
Sokolov también está aquí.
column3:

column3: ¿Está bien?

rematando los últimos detalles del Shagohod.
column3:

matado...

2.

column3: ¿Qué problema?
